title: Hepatitis A routine 2-dose series completed by age 2
action: Administer a 2-dose HepA series (minimum interval 6 months) at age 12-23 months

derived.min: routine series is given at age 12-23 months (the 23 sits on the next source line), so children turning 2 in the measurement year should have completed it
derived.max: single-year cohort of children turning 2 in the measurement year

derived.window: children age 2 at end of MY were born in MY-2; window runs from earliest possible birth date through end of MY

numerator.note: cannot enforce minimum age 12 months or the 6-month minimum interval between doses
